programme.desc: Arirang Special features a variety of unique and special programs produced by Arirang TV. These exciting programs will open your eyes to a new part of the world.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: Diplomat's Archives: Hidden Stories
programme.desc: As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet? "Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries. Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: Exploring Korean Literature
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.desc: South London zoologist and urban wildlife enthusiast, Lira Valencia, heads to Brazil to discover how humans and animals coexist in the most biodiverse country on earth. She comes face to face with the cuddly, but powerful capybaras in São Paulo's public parks, and meets the puma family who've become stars in the local community.

programme.desc: Liliths Mutter kommt zu Besuch. Die resolute Dame nörgelt an allem herum. Sie verlangt sogar, dass Lilith und Frasier ihre Hochzeit wiederholen. Derweil freut sich Sam auf eine Reise nach Atlantik City.

programme.title: Cheers: Hosen runter!
programme.desc: Lilith muss für ein paar Tage weg. Schweren Herzens überlässt sie Frasier die Verantwortung für das Haus. Seine erste verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe: Er soll die Laborratte Schnurri abholen und ordnungsgemäß versorgen.

programme.title: Cheers: Rebeccas Liebhaber
programme.desc: Rebecca fiebert einem Wiedersehen mit ihrer ersten großen Liebe Mark entgegen. Als er ankommt, ist sie so begeistert, dass ihr ein wichtiges Detail entgeht: Mark hat sich inzwischen zu seiner Homosexualität bekannt.

programme.title: Cheers: Krieg Der Kneipen – Teil 6
programme.desc: Gary hat seine ,,Old Town Tavern" verkauft. Die Cheers-Truppe hofft nun, den traditionellen Kneipenkrieg mit seinem Nachfolger fortzusetzen. Doch weit gefehlt: Der neue Besitzer scheint keinen Spaß zu verstehen. Er ist überdies ein berüchtigter Mafiaboss.

programme.title: Cheers: Oh, wie witzig!
programme.desc: Cliff versucht seit Jahren erfolglos, einen Witz in der Show von Johnny Carson unterzubringen. Erneut trifft eine Absage ein. Um Cliff aufzuheitern, verändert Norm den Inhalt des Briefes mit Tipp-Ex. Nun will Cliff sofort nach Hollywood fliegen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der große Tag – Teil 1
programme.desc: Der große Tag ist da: Die Hochzeit von Woody und Kelly soll stattfinden. Carla erstellt den Brautleuten ein Horoskop. Laut ihrer Prognose wird der Tag jedoch ein Desaster. Unterdessen legt sich Rebecca mit dem Chefkoch an.

programme.title: Cheers: Der große Tag – Teil 2
programme.desc: Sam versucht, Woodys großen Tag trotz aller Unglücksfälle noch zu retten. Schnell ist ein Ersatz für den verstorbenen Priester gefunden: Cliffs Onkel Roger. Der muss aber zunächst ausgenüchtert werden.

programme.title: Cheers: Die letzte Zigarette
programme.desc: Rebecca will endlich ihr Leben ändern. Sie setzt ihren Schwur sofort in die Tat um und will sofort das Rauchen aufgeben. Dummerweise setzt sie mit ihrer letzten Zigarette ungewollt das Cheers in Brand.

programme.title: Cheers: Konkurrenz für's Cheers
programme.desc: Nach dem schlimmen Brand im Cheers kann Sam die Bar endlich wieder eröffnen. Er schickt Norm und Cliff los, um Carla zu holen. Die beiden kommen nicht wieder. Seine treuen Freunde haben am Eröffnungsabend seiner Konkurrenz den Vorzug gegeben.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Glückspilsener
programme.desc: Norm hat offenbar seinen Traumjob gefunden: Er soll Bier testen. Dabei schlägt er sich so wacker, dass der Testveranstalter ihm eine Festanstellung in einer Brauerei anbietet.

programme.title: Cheers: Sex für's Vaterland
programme.desc: Sam heuert Henri, den Ex-Freund von Kelly, an. Der beginnt sofort mit seinen Frauengeschichten zu prahlen. Er fordert Sam schließlich zu einem Duell der Herzensbrecher heraus.

programme.title: Cheers: Vaterfreuden
programme.desc: Cliffs Ex-Freundin Maggie ist in der Stadt. Sie will sich offenbar mit ihm treffen. Schon prahlt Cliff mit seinen Liebhaberqualitäten. Diese müssen eindeutig der Grund für Maggies Rückkehr sein. Da erhält er eine schockierende Nachricht.

programme.title: Cheers: Szenen einer Ehe – Teil 1
programme.desc: Lilith hat Frasier vor den Augen Rebeccas betrogen. Da sie ihren Seitensprung selbst gestehen will, verpflichtet sie Rebecca zu absolutem Stillschweigen. Das bereitet Rebecca allerdings große Probleme.

programme.title: Cheers: Szenen einer Ehe – Teil 2
programme.desc: Lilith hat eine Affäre. Sie will Frasier verlassen, um mit ihrem Liebhaber in einen Ökobunker zu ziehen. Alles Bitten und Flehen stimmt sie nicht um. Frasier greift zu einer drastischen Maßnahme: Er will sich vom Dach des Cheers stürzen.

programme.title: Cheers: Der Seitensprung
programme.desc: Rebeccas Vater stattet ihr unverhofft einen Besuch ab, um ihren Lebenswandel zu kontrollieren. Nichts von dem, was er sieht, gefällt ihm. Kurzerhand beschließt der strenge Admiral, Rebecca wieder mit zu sich nach Hause zu nehmen.

programme.title: Cheers: Liebe ist...
programme.desc: Carlas Liebhaber Hill erleidet beim romantischen Tête-à-Tête einen Herzinfarkt. Carla kommt nur schwer umhin, endlich ihre Gefühle für Hill einzugestehen. Unterdessen glaubt der neurotische Cliff, dass Adolf Hitler neben ihm eingezogen ist.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Taschengelderhöhung
programme.desc: Rebeccas Vater stattet ihr unverhofft einen Besuch ab, um ihren Lebenswandel zu kontrollieren. Nichts von dem, was er sieht, gefällt ihm. Kurzerhand beschließt der strenge Admiral, Rebecca wieder mit zu sich nach Hause zu nehmen.

programme.title: Cheers: Er kann's nicht lassen
programme.desc: Sam malt sich berechtigte Chancen aus, seine vor Jahren unter großen Schmerzen verkaufte Corvette zurück zu erstehen. Denn die Witwe des Besitzers taucht unvermittelt im Cheers auf.

programme.title: Cheers: Voll reingefallen
programme.desc: Frasier scheint gute Chancen bei seiner jungen Sekretärin Shauna zu haben. Sam ermuntert ihn, ihre Einladung zum Dinner anzunehmen. Aber Frasier hat nicht damit gerechnet, dass das romantische Dinner im Kreis von Shaunas Familie stattfindet.

programme.title: Nespoutaný Django
programme.desc: Film NESPOUTANÝ DJANGO se odehrává na jihu Spojených států dva roky před vypuknutím Občanské války. Jamie Foxx v něm ztvárnil hlavní roli Djanga - otroka, jehož krutá minulost u bývalých vlastníků přivede tváří v tvář nájemnému lovci lidí německého původu Dr. Kingu Schultzovi. Schultz je na stopě vraždících bratrů Brittlových a jen Django ho může dovést k jeho odměně. Nekonvenční Schultz dá Djangovi slib, že ho pustí na svobodu poté, co dostane Brittlovi - živé či mrtvé. Díky jejich úspěšnému dopadení Schultz Djanga osvobodí, přesto se oba muži rozhodnou i nadále pokračovat ve společné cestě. Schultz pronásleduje s Djangem po svém boku nejhledanější kriminálníky na jihu. Django, který si tříbí životně důležité lovecké schopnosti, se zaměří na jediný cíl: najít a zachránit Broomhildu, ženu, kterou kvůli obchodu s otroky před lety ztratil. Djanga a Schultze jejich hledání nakonec dovede ke Calvinu Candiemu, vlastníkovi jedné neblaze proslulé plantáže zvané "Candyland". Django a...

programme.title: Buchty a klobásy
programme.desc: Buchty a klobásy, první mládeži nepřístupný animovaný film, vypráví o skupině potravin, které se pod vedením odvážné uzeniny rozhodnou odhalit pravdu o své existenci. Po vypadnutí z nákupního vozíku se náš hrdina párek a jeho noví přátelé vydají na nebezpečnou cestu napříč supermarketem, aby se vrátili do svých uliček dřív, než nastane 4. červenec, den slev.

programme.title: Stážisti
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) a Nick (Owen Wilson) jsou prodejci, jejichž kariéru potopil současný přetechnizovaný digitální svět. Ve snaze dokázat, že nepatří do starého železa, se jim podaří téměř nemožné: získat prestižní stáž ve firmě Google. Problém nastane, když zjistí, že zde nejsou sami. Mezi dalšími zájemci o pracovní místa je celá tlupa geniálních univerzitních studentů, Přestože si tedy dokázali proklestit cestu do onoho pověstného světa utopie, mají vyhráno jen napůl. Teď je čeká souboj s elitou národa sestávající z technicky nadaných géniů, v němž mají dokázat, že nutnost je vskutku matkou invence.

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: Píše se rok 2061. Zemi sužuje sucho a hladomor, docházejí základní potraviny a planeta čelí prudkým změnám klimatu. Lidské rase hrozí vyhynutí. Tomu by však mohl zabránit záhadný objev v oblasti výzkumu časoprostoru, díky kterému má lidstvo možná šanci na záchranu. Skupina vědců se musí vydat mimo naši sluneční soustavu a pokusit se najít pro lidské pokolení planetu, na které bude moci žít. Posádka lodi Endurance míří do mezigalaktického neznáma, do míst, kam se ještě nikdo před nimi nedostal. Pilota Coopa čeká zásadní rozhodnutí - bude muset volit mezi tím, zda ještě uvidí své děti, nebo se pokusí zachránit budoucnost lidstva.

programme.title: Město lží
programme.desc: Tupac Shakur a Notorious B.I.G., jedni z nejúspěšnějších raperů dvacátého století, byli v letech 1996 a 1997 nezávisle na sobě zavražděni. Ani v jednom případě nebyli pachatelé odhaleni a obě události tak zůstaly nevyřešené. O dvacet let později se k případům vrací americký hrdina a bývalý policista z Los Angeles Russell Poole. Ten se za pomoci investigativního novináře pokouší najít pojítka mezi oběma tragickými událostmi.

programme.title: Tess
programme.desc: Román britského spisovatele Thomase Hardyho patří k nejslavnějším viktoriánským románům a dočkal se více než desítky filmových a televizních adaptací. Ve své době vzbudil bouřlivou odezvu vzhledem k jeho kritice puritánské viktoriánské morálky. Odehrává se ve fiktivním jihoanglickém hrabství Wessex. Citlivá, venkovská dívka Tess, nesmlouvavá ve své hrdosti a morálce, se setkává s pokryteckými konvencemi vyšší společnosti. Polský režisér Roman Polanski si do role hlavní hrdinky vybral mladičkou Nastassju Kinskou, které v té době bylo pouhých osmnáct let. Film se celý natáčel ve Francii a dokonce menhiry Stonehenge byly znovu "postaveny".

programme.title: Snídaně na Plutu
programme.desc: 70. léta 20. století. Patricka Bradena pronásledovala smůla už od narození. Odložený nemanželský chlapec vychovávaný v cizí rodině, který se navíc od dětství rád obléká do dívčích šatů, to rozhodně nemůže mít v životě snadné. Patrick je ale svým způsobem šťastná povaha. Nepřipouští si svoji odlišnost ani posměch okolí. Překážky osudu překonává díky zvláštní směsi naivity a optimismu. Má v životě jediný cíl - najít svou skutečnou matku. Ta však dávno z městečka u irských hranic zmizela. Pohltilo ji velkoměsto, které není k mladému přivandrovalci zrovna laskavé a vlídné.

programme.title: Zelená kniha
programme.desc: Snímek Zelená kniha, který se odehrává v Americe roku 1962, vypráví srdceryvný skutečný příběh Tonyho "Pyska", amerického vyhazovače italského původu, který začne pracovat jako řidič dr. Dona Shirleyho, slavného a vzdělaného černošského klavíristy. Nesourodá dvojice se vydá na dvouměsíční turné po rasismem prostoupeném jihu Spojených států. Aby společně překonali nástrahy, musí si k sobě oba tvrdohlaví muži najít cestu skrz předsudky a humorné přešlapy.

programme.title: Revenant Zmrtvýchvstání
programme.desc: Velkolepý snímek REVENANT Zmrtvýchvstání vzdává hold neobyčejné síle lidského ducha a nabízí strhující divácký zážitek. Legendární lovec a dobrodruh Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) je během výpravy v americké divočině brutálně napaden medvědem a zanechán napospas smrti zbylými členy své lovecké skupiny. V neúnavné snaze přežít a najít vykoupení Glass přetrpí nepředstavitelný smutek, stejně jako zradu od svého souputníka Johna Fitzgeralda (Tom Hardy). Jedinou zbraní mu je nezlomná vůle a láska k rodině, díky níž se Glass pouští do boje s krutou zimou v zatím nezmapované krajině. Tento film, inspirovaný skutečným příběhem, získal tři Oscary: za nejlepší režii, kameru a pro herce v hlavní roli Leonarda DiCapria.

programme.title: Ricky Bobby: Nejrychlejší jezdec
programme.desc: Americká akční komedie režiséra Adama McKaye nás zavádí do světa profesionálních závodů sériových automobilů. Jejich senzací a národním hrdinou je Ricky Bobby (Will Ferrell), který vyhrává za každou cenu. On a jeho věrný parťák, kamarád od dětství Cal Naughton ml. (John C. Reilly), jsou vskutku nebojácná dvojka - fanoušci jim přezdívají "Hrom" a "Blesk", protože většinu závodů dojedou na prvním a druhém místě. Ten druhý ovšem bývá Cal. Jenže když je namyšlený jezdec francouzské formule 1 Jean Girard (Sacha Baron Cohen) vyzve k souboji o prvenství, Bobby musí nejen čelit svým běsům, ale hlavně si vybojovat právo stát na čele závodnické špičky.

programme.desc: S02E02 Fiasko s dárkem pro farnost rozpoutá spor mezi majorem Valchekem a Sobotkou. Valchek požádá komisaře Burella, aby si na Sobotku posvítil. Avon Barksdale řídí své impérium i z cely - radí synovci D ́Angelovi a snaží se dostat strážného, jenž neustále obtěžuje usvědčeného oblíbence Wee-Beye. Seržantka Beatrice Russellová z přístavní policie vyšetřuje podivný náklad v "řecké" nákladní lodi. McNulty nabídne pomoc s vyšetřováním, hlavně proto, aby se pomstil. programme.title: Loupež na úrovni
programme.desc: Crunch je notorický zloděj, ale rád by začal žít jinak. Když ho bratr přemluví, aby se zúčastnil poslední krádeže v životě, dají dohromady starou partu. Plán se však pomalu začíná hroutit... Crunch Calhoun (Kurt Russell) byl v Polsku se svými kumpány a bratrem Nickym, se kterými okradl místního mafiána o pravý obraz od Van Gogha. Při úprku z města, ale došlo k autonehodě a jeho bratr Nicky byl zatčen. Aby se zachránil, začal s policií spolupracovat a práskl Crunche. Ten pak musel jít na sedm let do vězení. Po pěti a půl roce byl propuštěn na svobodu a vydělává si jako kaskadér na motorce. Jeho bratr Nicky stále krade obrazy. Nicky ukradl obraz mužovi jménem Sunny. Policie chtěla Nickyho chytit, ale on je opět převezl a obraz od George Seurata schoval jinam, takže mu interpol nemohl nic dokázat. Interpolu pomáhá bývalý zloděj uměleckých děl Samuel Winter (Terence Stamp). Crunch je se svým kamarádem Franciem, když v tom za ním přijde člověk jménem Sunny, kterého okradl Nicky....

programme.desc: Chystá se odveta století. Rocky Balboa se znovu utkává s Apollo Creedem v pokračování jednoho z nejuznávanějších filmů v dějinách. Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) obstál v zápase se šampiónem těžké váhy a fanoušci volají po odvetě. Ale Rocky utrpěl v souboji těžká zranění a ohlásil odchod na odpočinek. Snaží se začít nový život, ale zjišťuje, že svému skutečnému poslání stejně neunikne. Ring ho láká a Rocky se musí připravit na zápas svého života.

programme.title: Muži v černém 2
programme.desc: Uplynuly čtyři roky od okamžiku, kdy K a J – agenti tajné neoficiální organizace MIB dohlížející na utajené mimozemské imigranty na Zemi – odvrátili velkou intergalaktickou katastrofu. Tehdy čerstvě získaný agent J se v organizaci etabloval, zatímco jeho starší zkušený kolega K se vrátil k pohodlnému civilnímu životu a pracuje na poště. Během rutinního vyšetřování však J odhalí spiknutí řízené zlou kytothianskou stvůrou Serleenou, vystupující v podobě sexy modelky luxusního spodního prádla. Serleena však obsadí budovu organizace MIB a jako rukojmí si vezme jeho zaměstnance. K nezbývá než požádat o pomoc jediného muže, který mu s řešením situace může pomoci – zpohodlnělého J.

programme.title: Takoví normální zabijáci
programme.desc: Režisér Oliver Stone namířil příběh milenecké dvojice amorálních zabijáků, kteří milují vraždění stejně jako jeden druhého, proti soudobé pop-kultuře, fascinované jakýmkoliv projevem zla. Autorem námětu tohoto kriminální dramatu je Quentin Tarantino. Inspirací pro brilantně šokující snímek Takoví normální zabijáci byla divácká obliba reportáží a rozhovorů s masovými vrahy, z nichž se působením televizního média staly slavné a někdy i oblíbené osobnosti. V tomto prostředí paradoxně sláva podněcuje touhu po krvi, bulvární novináři stoupají stále výš a celému národu připadají vraždy zábavné. Zatímco Tarantino ve svých vlastních filmech tyto jevy rád provokativně paroduje, Stone se pokouší o krutě angažovanou a zároveň atraktivní výpověď o iracionalitě násilí v moderním světě.

programme.title: Lepší už to nebude
programme.desc: Trojnásobný držitel Oscara Jack Nicholson exceluje v hlavní roli Melvina Udalla, podivínského a uštěpačného spisovatele, který trpí obsedantně kompulzivní poruchou. Melvinovu každodenní rutinu zcela vykolejí nepřítomnost servírky z jeho oblíbené kavárny Carol Connellyové (Helen Huntová), která ho jako jediná dokáže vystát. Když se Melvin dozví, že má těžce nemocného syna, rozhodne se jí pomoci, aby se jeho život zase rychle vrátil do zaběhnutých kolejí. Vděčná Carol se noří čím dál hlouběji do chaotického života misantropického mrzouta. Když do Melvinova života vstoupí i nemocný soused Simon (Greg Kinnear) se svým psíkem jménem Verdell, Melvin, Carol i Simon začnou jeden o druhém - ale i sami o sobě - zjišťovat věci, kterých by se ani ve snu nenadáli.

programme.title: Mezi světy
programme.desc: V 90.letech na předměstí Melbourne si desetiletá Mona uvědomuje, že jako Tongan-Australanka není stejná jako její bílá matka a rodina.

programme.title: Vyměřený čas
programme.desc: V tomhle sexy, stylovém akčním thrilleru si zahrál Justin Timberlake a Amanda Seyfried. V budoucnosti, kde jsou doslova čas peníze a stárnutí se zastaví na hranici pětadvaceti let, je jediným způsobem, jak přežít, získat víc času - musíte ho však vydělat, ukrást anebo zdědit. Jenže když je chudý muž z nižší třídy (Timberlake) falešně obviněn z vraždy, spojí se s krásnou dědičkou (Seyfried) a snaží se vymyslet způsob, jak podkopat zkorumpovaný systém, dřív než jim odtikají poslední minuty jejich života!

programme.title: Desperado
programme.desc: V pokračování osudů osamělého hudebníka (El Mariachi z roku 1992) se tentokrát mariachi (Antonio Banderas) vrhne po hlavě do temného podsvětí, aby se oděný v černém hávu a s kytarou přes rameno vydal po stopě posledního z neslavných mexických drogových magnátů Bucha (Joaquim de Almeida). Ten mu v předchozím snímku zabil milenku a do ruky zavrtal kulku, aby nemohl hrát na kytaru. Za pomoci přítele a svůdné majitelky knihkupectví Caroliny (Salma Hayeková) Bucha sleduje, pronásledován gangem jeho nemilosrdných zabijáků. Film vrcholí divokou přestřelkou, ve které už nejde o čest, ale o život.

programme.title: Steve Jobs
programme.desc: Snímek "Steve Jobs" se odehrává na pozadí uvedení tří legendárních produktů na trh a končí v roce 1998, kdy byl představen počítač iMac. Zavádí nás do zákulisí digitální revoluce a vykresluje intimní portrét geniálního muže, který stál v jejím středu. Režisérem filmu je oscarový Danny Boyle a scénář napsal držitel Oscara Aaron Sorkin na základě bestsellerového životopisu zakladatele společnosti Apple od Waltera Isaacsona. Michael Fassbender hraje Steva Jobse, průkopnického zakladatele společnosti Apple, a v hlavní roli Joanny Hoffmanové, bývalé marketingové šéfky společnosti Macintosh, se představuje držitelka Oscara® Kate Winsletová. Spoluzakladatele společnosti Apple Steva Wozniaka hraje Seth Rogen a Jeff Daniels vystupuje jako bývalý generální ředitel Applu John Sculley.

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: V energickém akčním filmu se Rocky utkává se svým dosud nejsilnějším protivníkem - krutým svalovcem jménem Clubber Lang (Mr. T). V možná nejnapínavějším a nejpoutavějším dílu celé série jde Rocky od jednoho vítězství ke druhému, podepisuje lukrativní smlouvy a stává se slavným po celém světě. Když ale "italský hřebec" utrpí potupnou porážku od Clubbera Langa, zdá se, že pomalu ztrácí své výsadní postavení. S pomocí odvěkého rivala Apolla Creeda (Carl Weathers) se Rocky snaží znovu získat bojového ducha, aby se s Langem mohl utkat ve vyčerpávající odvetě o světového šampiona v těžké váze.

programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.desc: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight

programme.title: Puccini - La Boheme
programme.desc: In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo; Norwegian conductor Eivind Gullberg Jensen leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the National Opera Oslo.

programme.title: Works by Mendelssohn & Hensel
programme.desc: A 2020 performance of Mendelssohn and Hensel at the Mendelssohn House in Leipzig, Germany.

programme.title: Berlioz
programme.desc: Maestro Mariss Jansons conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Hector Berlioz's "Symphonie," Op. 14; this performance is part of the Europakonzert 2001, recorded at Hagia Irene in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Mikhail Pletnev Conducts Rimski-Korsakov
programme.desc: Russian conductor and pianist Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in performances of Nikolai Rimsky-Korsakov's music.

programme.title: Faure's Requiem
programme.desc: Winchester Cathedral Orchestra and the English Chamber Choir perform the piece; host John Gielgud.

programme.title: Chopin: Piano Concertos No. 1 & No. 2
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performances of Chopin's Piano Concertos No. 1, Op. 11 and No. 2, Op. 21; soloists are Nikolai Demidenko and Evgeny Kissin.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Odds Against Tomorrow
programme.desc: When bigoted ex-con Earl Slater agrees to carry out a heist with a disgraced former cop and his cohorts – one of whom is Black – tensions mount as the job comes together, until Earl’s seething hatred erupts, risking the heist...and their lives!

programme.title: City Lights
programme.desc: With the aid of a wealthy erratic tippler, a dewy-eyed tramp who has fallen in love with a sightless flower girl accumulates money to be able to help her medically.

programme.title: King Creole
programme.desc: Elvis Presley gives Bourbon Street a new beat in King Creole. He plays a troubled youth whose singing sets the French Quarter rockin’.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger (who won a Best Actor Oscar® for his performance) shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®, including Best Picture and Best Adapted Screenplay. Lee Grant and Warren Oates also star.

programme.title: Pardners
programme.desc: A rich momma's boy returns west with the son of his murdered father's partner to foil a gang trying to gain control of his family ranch. They accidentally clean up the town.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft-misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Star Named Arnold Is Born - Part 1
programme.desc: Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El asesino probablemente esperaba cubrir sus huellas escenificando la escena del crimen. Pero los investigadores descubrieron el intento casi de inmediato y recurrieron a la ciencia forense para saber qué sucedió esa noche realmente.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1981, Cassie Hansen, de 6 años, desapareció de su iglesia de Minnesota durante una misa vespertina. Después de recibir un aviso de que se vio a un hombre mayor cargando a una persona pequeña, la policía encontró el cuerpo de Cassie en un basurero.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En el 2007, Shamaia Smith desaparece de un club de striptease en East Hartford, Connecticut. La policía considera varios patrones del club, pero se enfocan en un comerciante local, Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1998, una actuación de asesinato misterioso en Maryland se convierte en una verdadera novela policíaca cuando se descubre el cuerpo gravemente quemado de Stephen Hricko en su habitación de hotel.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: La víctima era querida y exitosa, lo cual hace que la brutalidad del crimen sea más difícil de entender.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1985, 121 personas en Dakota del Sur y Minnesota sufrieron una misteriosa enfermedad. Solo había habido un brote como ese, y cuando sucedió entonces, nadie pudo entender por qué.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En poco más de un mes, dos mujeres que han vivido en el mismo complejo de apartamentos fueron brutalmente asesinadas.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando un joven bombero murió de lo que parecía ser una enfermedad cardíaca grave pero no diagnosticada, su familia y amigos quedaron devastados, pero no tenían pruebas de algún juego sucio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En el año 2000, Judy Southern llegó a casa del trabajo y recibió un disparo de un hombre armado que esperaba dentro. Su esposo llegó poco después, llamó a los servicios de emergencia y la llevó al hospital.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un cirujano es apuñalado hasta la muerte y el sospechoso más probable es visto en un restaurante al momento del asesinato.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: El cuerpo de un rico empresario estadounidense fue encontrado en su auto de alquiler. Los dientes y fragmentos de huesos fueron los únicos restos.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Sombra de duda
programme.desc: Una mujer es asesinada a tiros en su tienda solo un día antes de testificar contra el hombre acusado de robarla.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un asesinato brutal, muchos sospechosos y pruebas contradictorias, pero los forenses fueron claros en una cosa: el asesino conocía a su víctima. Y eso les dio a los investigadores una ventaja.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Parece que una mujer ha perdido el control de su camioneta SUV y ha caído en el barranco de un arroyo profundo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Ryan Erwin
programme.desc: He was awarded the 2018 Teaching Star of the Year winner by the Utah Middle School Teachers Association. His comedy comes a variety of sources from growing up with two deaf parents, to asking for the details on the latest girl drama at his school.

programme.title: Karen Rontowski
programme.desc: Karen Rontowski's fast-paced, quirky and charmingly optimistic comedy has been featured in clubs, TV, radio, and at corporate events all around the world. Her stand- up showcases endearing, self-effacing and intelligent characters that catch you by surprise every time. Karen uniquely blends comedy with her experience as a Paranormal Investigator and Reiki master. From fun with her family to her travels all over this great country Karen has fun where ever she goes. Her lighthearted confusion entertains kids of all ages. She is fascinated with the “afterlife” is convinced she will someday have a near death experience because, “I never finish anything.” She explains, “Sometimes a ghost will just do the same thing over and over in life. That's why I want to move into a house that is haunted by a maid." Karen's comedy is now featured in the new line of greeting cards called “Frank and Funny” sold at Target stores everywhere and is the comedy writer for “Haunted Magazine.” She is a regular on the Bob and Tom Radio Show and is a featured performer on their CD. Karen has appeared on The Late Show with David Letterman, Sirius Satellite Radio, Comics Unleashed, Comedy.com, Live at Gotham and Comedy Central. She has opened for show biz legends including Bob Hope, Ray Charles, David Brenner and the Monkees.

programme.title: Nikki Carr: I Wish These Were Jokes.
programme.desc: Nikki Carr is 57 and feeling great. After all, she's got the career where all you have to do is be yourself and have a good time . . . two things she subsequently gave up for her goal weight.

programme.title: Heath Harmison: Comedy in COVID
programme.desc: Heath Harmison provides the people relief during these trying times

programme.title: Spencer James
programme.desc: Spencer has performed all over North America, he has won festivals, and he was recently featured on Fox's television show “Laughs.” Yet now, with the title as a Las Vegas headliner, he brings all of his talents to the stage for a once in a generation experience.

programme.title: Kellen Erskine
programme.desc: Kellen Erskine was featured on season 7 of NBC's America's Got Talent. His jokes have appeared in many publications including the Reader's Digest. Kellen has been a finalist of both the San Francisco International Comedy Competition and the Great American Comedy Festival. This year he performed at the prestigious Bridgetown Comedy Festival in Portland, Oregon. Kellen opens regularly for Frank Caliendo of FOX's NFL Sunday.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: If you're looking for the reason why to use a ladle to eat lucky charms, or why being a Bigfoot hunter is better than being a comedian, your search ends with Brent Terhune, who's "known from time to time, to tell a few jokes.

programme.title: Russ Nagel
programme.desc: Russ has become recognized in the entertainment industry for achieving more laughs per minute than any comedian working the circuit today and has also been seen on The Nashville Network, A&E's Comedy on the Road, Showtime's Comedy Club Network, the WB, Spike TV, Comedy Central and the list goes on and on. Being a 26+ year veteran of the comedy stage, Russ keeps the laughs coming fast and furious with an array of topics ranging from family and marriage, to travel and current events, and yes he even throws in some biker stuff too.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E07 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: 4 Deserts Race Series
programme.desc: Welcome to the world of the 4 Deserts Race Series, the only international ultramarathon series which mixes local culture with trail running. The 4 Deserts Race Series is widely recognized as one of the most prestigious outdoor running series in the world. It is made up of 4 of the most iconic and toughest races in the world - the Sahara Race in Egypt and Namibia, the Gobi March between China and Mongolia, the Atacama Crossing in Chile and The Last Desert in Antarctica. Competitors traverse 250 kilometers in seven days over rough country terrain with only a place in a tent and water provided and support from the very best operational and medical teams provided. Through this documentary, we will travel to two destinations of the 2017 4 Deserts race calendar; China for the Gobi March in the great Gobi Desert and Chile for the Atacama Crossing in the Atacama Desert, an area of extraordinary beauty and astounding natural wonders.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E07 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: What if Hitler Had Won the War
programme.desc: The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.

programme.title: Designed for Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler’s mastery of propaganda, and his instinctive skill for effective design, helps win huge popular support for the Nazi party, a vital step in its march towards total power.

programme.title: Hitler's Highways
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler promises to make Germany great again with his ambitious plans to create 22,000 kms of motorway and build one and half million “People’s Cars” every year.

programme.title: The Industry of War
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to rebuild Germany’s military strength after its humiliating defeat in the First World War by stealing raw materials from abroad.

programme.title: A Culture of Control
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler is determined to change the way German people think and feel by creating a new, Nazi form of art and culture. He takes control of all forms of media to spread Nazi propaganda.

programme.title: Himmler's Empire of Terror
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler’s bid for power depends on his most loyal and violent supporters, the SS. They use intimidation, detention, terror and even murder to defeat all the Nazis political enemies.

programme.title: Retreat from Reality
programme.desc: Hitler uses technology and terror to keep Germans fighting to the bitter end.

programme.title: The Moon Landing and the Nazis
programme.desc: The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

programme.title: Rising Sun
programme.desc: After briefly setting the scene, Episode One delves into the early years of Emperor Hirohito’s reign.

programme.title: For the Sake of the Country
programme.desc: Episode Two explores the military’s tightening control over Japanese society, the disbanding of labour unions and influences upon education.

programme.title: The Sun that Shines
programme.desc: Japan seized more than 2,500,000 km² of land in Southeast Asia and almost the entire western half of the Pacific.

programme.title: An Extraordinary Measure
programme.desc: On the day that Nagasaki was bombed, the Trans Baikal and 2nd Far East Fronts of the Red Army invaded Manchuria, the 1st Far East Front moved from Vladivostok.

programme.title: Countdown to Surrender: The End
programme.desc: The final act of the Second World War is its most costly episode. More than one million German soldiers die in 1945 alone.

programme.desc: 2018 Yuletide drama with Madeline Leon. When a disgraced PR expert tries to rebuild her reputation by helping a failing Christmas village, she discovers she has a lot to learn about life - and love.

programme.desc: 2019 Intriguing Christmas romance with Ashley Newbrough. A relationship advice columnist receives an unsigned love letter. But as she hunts for the mystery writer, can she also find true love?

programme.title: Dashing Home For Christmas

programme.title: Finding Father Christmas
programme.desc: 2016 Family drama with Erin Krakow and Niall Matter. Miranda never knew who her father was, but when she finds a clue about his identity, will this Christmas deliver what she's always longed for?

programme.title: Death on High Mountain
programme.desc: A major robbery spirals out of control when two young men cross paths with ruthless Mexican bandits and a corrupt businessman—both desperate to reclaim the stolen loot. Caught in a deadly chase, the youths face danger, betrayal, and the fight for survival.

programme.title: Tepepa
programme.desc: In early 20th-century Mexico, the guerrilla leader Tepepa is saved from execution by Doctor Price, an Englishman. Tepepa, a hero of the Revolution, is curious about the doctor’s motives. The chilling answer: to kill him himself. A deadly game of cat and mouse begins between Tepepa and the ruthless police chief, Cascorro.

programme.title: Kill Django... Kill First
programme.desc: Johnny MaGee arrives in a mining town and clashes with banker Anthony Burton, who uses underhanded tactics to acquire gold mines. As Burton manipulates the locals, including offering to wipe out a doctor’s debts in exchange for his sister’s marriage, Johnny finds an ally in bounty hunter Ted. But Burton’s reach goes far beyond the mines.

programme.title: Three Ruthless Ones
programme.desc: The Walker brothers took different paths—one an outlaw, one a Marshal, one a rancher. Yet they share one goal: avenging their father’s murder. When they finally find the killer, their clashing ideals lead to a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Seven Alone
programme.desc: A frontier family crosses the U.S. by wagon train, hoping for a better life in the Oregon Territory.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Trade Your Guns for a Coffin
programme.desc: Sartana, a bounty hunter and gunfighter, witnesses a gold robbery and arrives in a suspicious town run by Samuel Spencer. Hired to protect the next shipment, Sartana fends off numerous incompetent villains, surviving their attempts on his life. Meanwhile, his nemesis, Sabbath—known for his white coat and parasol—arrives in town. With tensions rising, Sartana and Sabbath are headed for a final showdown to settle the score.

programme.title: Dig Your Grave Friend... Sabata's Coming
programme.desc: Steve McGowan returns from war to avenge his father’s murder by a ruthless landowner. Imprisoned, he escapes with a bandit and steals a stagecoach—only to find the villain’s fiancée inside. As hired guns close in, alliances shift, and the fight for justice takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: A Minute to Pray, a Second to Die
programme.desc: In Tuscola, New Mexico, the Governor offers amnesty papers to all outlaws but gunfighter Clay McCord's appearance triggers a violent confrontation between the local marshal, McCord, and other outlaws.

programme.title: And the Crows Will Dig Your Grave
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Wells Fargo hires gunmen to protect against increasing bandit attacks. Jeff Sullivan, driven by revenge for his murdered wife, joins the team to hunt down Glenn Kovacks and his gang. Alongside bounty hunter Pancho Corrales, Sullivan faces treachery, culminating in a deadly showdown where only he survives to save a prisoner.

programme.title: Django Kill... If You Live, Shoot!
programme.desc: Various factions, feud over stolen gold in a surreal town.

programme.title: If you meet Sartana... Pray for your Death
programme.desc: Crooked bankers plan an insurance swindle and hire a Mexican gang to steal the bank's gold but they also pay Lasky's gang to kill the Mexicans.

programme.desc: The sole surviving Texas Ranger (Klinton Spilsbury) of an ambush arranged by outlaw leader Major Bartholomew "Butch" Cavendish (Christopher Lloyd) returns to fight back as a great masked western hero, The Lone Ranger.

programme.title: Mountain Men S13E3 -The North Slope
programme.desc: Lauro travels north of the Arctic Circle with his team of sled dogs to hunt caribou; Daniel rebuilds an old floating cabin using driftwood logs and the power of tides.

programme.title: Alone S12E2 -Best Laid Plans
programme.desc: Faced with skittish game and unfamiliar plants, the final group of survivalists quickly learn their earliest strategies will be met with unforgiving resistance.

programme.title: iCarly: Räuber und Piraten
programme.desc: Zwei Cops haben sich bei Carly und Spencer eingenistet, denn sie haben den dringenden Verdacht, dass im Laden gegenüber Raubkopien von DVDs verkauft werden.

programme.title: iCarly: Ein schickes Angebot
programme.desc: Die Eliteschule Briarwood zieht in Erwägung, Carly ein Stipendium anzubieten. Carly ist sich nicht sicher, ob sie dieses Angebot annehmen soll. Doch Sam und Freddie wissen, sie müssen Carlys Meinung ändern.

programme.title: iCarly: Fechten wir's aus!
programme.desc: Freddie braucht eine Auszeit von den Mädchen. Daher ist er Spencer mehr als dankbar, als er ihn fragt, ob er mit zum Fechten kommen möchte. Allerdings wird es kompliziert, als Spencer ihn gegen den fiesen Doug Toder antreten lässt.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly TV
programme.desc: Der Programmchef eines großen Fernsehsenders ist auf der Suche nach einem neuen Hit und will iCarly zur TV Show machen. Aber Carly und Co. sind bald enttäuscht von den großen Veränderungen, die der Programmchef durchsetzen möchte.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Dreifach-Date
programme.desc: Als ihr Freund Gibby zu schüchtern ist, ein Mädchen, welches er toll findet, um eine Verabredung zu bitten, beschließen Carly und Co. eine Gewinnshow zu machen, bei der er ein Date gewinnen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly wird von den iWeb Awards auserwählt, in Japan für den Preis der Besten Comedy anzutreten. Carly, Sam und Freddie proben für den Auftritt einen Extra-Sketch ein und reisen zusammen mit Spencer und Mrs. Benson nach Japan.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 2
programme.desc: Da der Flieger nicht in Japan landet, müssen Carly und Co. mit dem Fallschirm abspringen, um zu den iWeb Awards zu kommen. Alles scheint gut zu gehen, bis sie auf Kyoko und Yuki treffen, die eine gemeinen Plan verfolgen.

programme.title: iCarly: Trouble in Tokio – Teil 3
programme.desc: Nachdem Kyoko und Yuki Carly und Co. im Nirgendwo ausgesetzt haben, laufen die Drei völlig verzweifelt durch die Gegend. Spencer und Mrs. Benson, die sich befreit haben, versuchen, die Kids zu finden. Schaffen sie es rechtzeitig, Carly zu finden?

programme.title: iCarly: Alle lieben Shane
programme.desc: Als sich Carly und Sam für den gleichen Jungen interessieren, schwören sie sich, ihn nicht zwischen sie kommen zu lassen. Als sich jedoch beide um seine Aufmerksamkeit bemühen, wird ihre Freundschaft auf eine harte Probe gestellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Pack Rat
programme.desc: Carly muss eingreifen, als sie bemerkt, dass Spencer eine Videospielsucht entwickelt. Währenddessen versucht Sam Freddie davon zu überzeugen, dass er vom Pech verfolgt sein wird, wenn er eine Ketten-Email nicht weiterleitet.

programme.title: iCarly: Raus aus den Schulden
programme.desc: Sam ist beschämt als Freddie und Carly ihr sagen, wieviel Geld sie ihnen bereits schuldig ist. Sam versucht alles, um es ihnen zurückzuzahlen. Sie überlegt sogar, sich einen richtigen Job zu beschaffen.

programme.title: iCarly: Achtung, böser Stiefvater!
programme.desc: Bei iCarly startet mal wieder die Rubrik 'Jetzt zeigen wir's Lewbert'. Dabei wird Lewbert durch eine Explosion verletzt. Die Kids wollen den Protier wieder gesund pflegen. Doch dann springt Mrs. Benson ein und es kommt zu einer kleinen Romanze.

programme.title: iCarly: Kokosnusscremtorte
programme.desc: Als Carly und Co. Freddie zu ihrem Lieblingskuchenladen bringen, erfahren sie, dass der Besitzer verstorben ist und auch seine Rezepte eventuell für immer verloren sein könnten.

programme.title: iCarly: Gut geküsst ist halb gewonnen
programme.desc: Sam bekommt mit, wie Freddie Carly gesteht, niemals ein Mädchen geküsst zu haben und veröffentlicht dieses Geheimnis auf der Webseite.

programme.title: iCarly: Auto oder Aus
programme.desc: Jeffrey, angeblich Sohn von Autohändler Mr. Flanken, will bei iCarly ein Preisausschreiben starten. Der erste Preis, ein neues Auto, soll von seinem Vater gestiftet werden. Nevel gewinnt den Preis, nur stellt sich die Frage, ob es das Auto wirklich gibt.

programme.title: iCarly: Freddie gegen Fred
programme.desc: Freddie bekennt ganz offen seinen Unmut über Freds Popularität im Internet, was den sensiblen Fred dazu bringt, seine Videos nicht länger online zu stellen. Doch jetzt sind die Fans unglücklich!

programme.title: iCarly: Ein Colt für alle Fälle
programme.desc: Carly, Sam und Freddie bekommen die Möglichkeit, mit dem bekannten Kampfsportler Jackson Colt ein Interview zu machen. Und zwar backstage während einer Martial-Arts-Veranstaltung.

programme.title: iCarly: Wurzeln, Beeren und Kompost
programme.desc: Mr. Henning fordert im Naturwissenschaftsunterricht Carly und Co. auf, ein umweltfreundliches Projekt zur Grünen Woche zu entwickeln. Carly baut einen illegalen Atomkraft- Generator.

programme.title: iCarly: Amerika singt
programme.desc: Bei 'Amerika singt' steht das Finale an: David Archuleta gegen Wade Collins. iCarly ruft während der Web-Show dazu auf, für David Archuleta zu stimmen. Das Gewissen nagt an Carly und Co., so dass sie ein Musikvideo für den Verlierer machen.

programme.title: iCarly: Sam ist ein Mädchen
programme.desc: Sam hat Geburtstag und Carly organisiert für sie eine große Feier. Viele sagen ein paar Worte zu Sam.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly lernt einen richtigen Bad Boy kennen. Sie ist von Griffin zuerst gar nicht begeistert, verliebt sich aber schließlich in ihn, was wiederum Spencer überhaupt nicht gefällt. Carly und Griffin versuchen alles, um sich weiter sehen zu können.

programme.title: iCarly: Hier kommt Missy
programme.desc: Als Carlys alte Freundin Missy aus Seattle zurückzieht, glaubt Sam, Missy wolle sie als Carlys beste Freundin verdrängen. Sam riecht zwar den Braten, aber weder Freddie noch Carly wollen ihr glauben. Ob Missys wahre Absichten dennoch entlarvt werden?

programme.title: iCarly: Gib mir iCarly zurück!
programme.desc: Nevel hat sich die iCarly-URL unter den Nagel gerissen und will sie nur zurückgeben, wenn Carly ihn küsst. Unterdessen hat Spencer versehentlich 200 Kissen bestellt, doch Spencer weiß, wie man aus dieser Situation das Beste macht.

programme.title: iCarly: Spind 239
programme.desc: Sam und Freddie haben bei einem schulinternen Wettbewerb gemeinsam den begehrten Spind 239 gewonnen. Doch das Teilen will nicht so recht klappen. Carly bekommt von Spencer Kunstunterricht.

programme.title: iCarly: Vier Fäuste für iCarly – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly und Martial-Arts-Champion Shelby Marx vereinbaren einen Show-Kampf, wobei die Einnahmen einem guten Zweck zur Verfügung gestellt werden sollen. Bei der Pressekonferenz stürzt Carly aus Versehen über Shelbys Großmutter.

programme.title: iCarly: Vier Fäuste für iCarly – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly und Martial-Arts-Champion Shelby Marx vereinbaren einen Show-Kampf, wobei die Einnahmen einem guten Zweck zur Verfügung gestellt werden sollen. Bei der Pressekonferenz stürzt Carly aus Versehen über Shelbys Großmutter.

programme.title: iCarly: Die iCarly Awards
programme.desc: Carly und Co. verleihen zehn 'iCarly Awards'. Spencer sollte die Statuen basteln, doch der hat versehentlich eine Riesenstatue gebaut. Um auf die Schnelle zehn Gewinne zusammenzuschustern, holt er sich sechs europäische Bademodenmodels zur Hilfe.

programme.title: iCarly: Die doppelte Sam
programme.desc: Freddie versucht zu beweisen, dass Melanie, Sam's Zwillingsschwester, nur ausgedacht ist. Um Sam zu enttarnen, bittet Freddie Melanie um ein Date.

programme.title: iCarly: Böse verliebt – Teil 2
programme.desc: Griffin, ein Junge, der ins Haus gezogen ist, 'borgt' sich Spencers Motorrad, um damit eine Spritztour zu machen. Der Diebstahl fliegt auf und anstatt ihn anzuzeigen, nimmt sich Spencer seiner an und bringt ihm etwas Bildhauerei bei.

This captivating series explores the diverse behaviors that define survival—hunting and feeding strategies, family bonds, defense tactics, and the intricacies of courtship and mating. Who reigns supreme in the wild? Discover the untold stories of nature's fiercest competitors and most fascinating creatures.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit S1E5 -Chasing Scales
programme.desc: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

programme.title: Life's Journey S1E2 -Life's Lessons
programme.desc: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death.

programme.title: Wild Castles S1E1 -Heidelberg
programme.desc: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey and acts as a spawning ground for nearby amphibians.

programme.title: Wild Castles S1E2 -Carcassonne
programme.desc: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of history's greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife. Birds, wild boar, and armies of insects endure in its bountiful surroundings.

programme.title: Wild Castles S1E3 -Predjama
programme.desc: Discover the world's largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also serves as a haven for the birds, boars, and mountain goats that live in the region.

programme.title: Wild Castles S1E4 -Alhambra
programme.desc: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spain's Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the region’s wildlife. With its many streams and fountains, Alhambra serves amphibian, fish, and bird alike.

programme.title: Wild Castles S1E5 -Neuschwanstein
programme.desc: Learn how one of the world's most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures. From the Alpine ibex to the majestic swans, this castle has been a natural haven for centuries.

programme.title: America's Wild Border: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

programme.title: Planet Shark S1E1 -Ultimate Predator
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its prey’s heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

programme.title: Planet Shark S1E2 -Ocean Voyagers
programme.desc: Navigate the ocean’s vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

programme.title: Planet Shark S1E3 -In the Extreme
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

programme.title: Wild Latin America S1E1 -Humpback Birth of a Giant
programme.desc: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whale’s life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

programme.title: Wild Latin America S1E2 -Squirrel Monkey Island
programme.desc: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where it’s mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E1 -The Fickle River
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

credits.director: Justin Purefoy: Director & DOP; Adjoa Andoh: Narrator

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E2 -Blood and Dust
programme.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta’s loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

credits.director: Justin Purefoy: Director & DOP; Adjoa Andoh: Narrator

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E1 -Lions
programme.desc: Chart the lion’s nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

credits.director: Lorne Townsend: Director; Anja Taylor: Writer; Scott Sinclair
Alan Erson: Executive Producers; Craig Meade; Head of International Television

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E2 -Tigers
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

credits.director: Lorne Townsend: Director; Anja Taylor: Writer; Scott Sinclair
Alan Erson: Executive Producers; Craig Meade; Head of International Television

programme.title: Into the Wild India S1E5 -Rana: Queen of the Jungle
programme.desc: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World S1E1 -Summer Cubs
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World S1E2 -Surviving the Flood
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E1 -The Fickle River

programme.title: Vampire Genesis
programme.desc: Half-alien Teh'a flees across galaxies, hunted by a race of parasitic rulers disguised as Earth's vampires. With rebels by her side, she seeks a legendary creature: the first vampire, powerful enough to end their reign of terror.

programme.title: Ultimate Betrayal
programme.desc: Jerry, a recently unemployed accountant, and his wife Stephanie face financial struggles after Jerry loses his job. They invite Jerry's best friend and mentor, Lionel, a music producer, to stay with them. Lionel turns out to be manipulative and begins a rivalry between Jerry and his friend Shawn. Lionel also tries to seduce Stephanie by exploiting her financial vulnerability. This betrayal leads to a chain of events that ends tragically, revealing a dark side of Jerry that he never knew existed.

programme.title: The Hit List
programme.desc: Marcus is a ladies’ man until he meets Nia, the woman of his dreams. However, Nia’s brother has a psychic ability that threatens to expose Marcus as the player he is, leading him to extreme measures with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Love and Deceit 2
programme.desc: Carolyn, a successful businesswoman moves to a new town in hopes of laying down some roots after her divorce. She joins a local women’s group ran by Beverly Jordan a respected therapist to help process her emotions. When in reality, she’s there to rekindle an old flame with a former lover, who happens to be Beverly’s husband.

programme.title: The Good Sister
programme.desc: Raven moves in with her sister Devin and her husband in Atlanta, where she begins to dig her claws into Devin’s life and home, and seducing her husband. Devin must make a choice that could be deadly to save her own life and happiness.

programme.title: The Housekeeper 2
programme.desc: After moving on from her sordid past, Sharease flourishes in her new life and success. When her son Adonis kidnapped, she seeks help from a ghost of her past to rescue him.

programme.title: Knee Deep: The Series
programme.desc: Gotti, a rising kingpin in Dallas , looks to restructure his organization by adding women to his leadership

programme.title: Knee Deep: The Series
programme.desc: Gotti reflects on his past and ponders on his relationship with Stacy and the brutal choices that forged his life in streets.

programme.title: Knee Deep: The Series
programme.desc: After Simone fails to Kill Ried, Nivea launches a calculated plan to infiltrate Gotti’s inner circle.

programme.title: Crash Out
programme.desc: An up-and-coming podcast starts to take off, they land an exclusive interview with a controversial wellness guru. But when an on-air confrontation begins to escalate, the effects of his own product begin to take over with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Deadly Surrogate
programme.desc: When a young married couple suffer the pain of infertility, they look to the path of surrogacy and come upon Alana as a potential candidate. As the three become intertwined, tensions begin to unravel and threaten to consume them.

programme.title: It's Complicated AF
programme.desc: After an intense romance, Ryan and Quaves make the crazy decision to get married without having met in person. But as friends and family gather in Houston for a whirlwind wedding weekend, everything spirals into chaos as the bridal party clashes over secret agendas, bruised egos, and a stolen parking spot. A romantic comedy about fate, bad timing, and the kind of love that refuses to show up quietly.

programme.title: The Shining Star of Lawrence Hilton-Jacobs
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of one of America’s favorite actors, Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs (Welcome Back Kotter, The Jacksons: An American Dream, Claudine, Cooley High). In fascinating form, Mr. Hilton Jacobs takes us on his life’s journey from his childhood beginning in Harlem, New York to the bright lights of the Broadway Stage and on to becoming a Hollywood movie and television star.

programme.title: Transcend
programme.desc: Maranda spent her life looking for a protector, only to find herself lost in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal. From the wreckage of abandonment to a life-altering crossroads, her survival isn't just about escaping the past, it’s about surviving herself.

programme.title: The Lyric
programme.desc: An aspiring singer discovers the lyrics in a song written for her could lead her to the killer of the writer who wrote it.

programme.title: The Betrayal 4: Wicked Nights
programme.desc: Wicked days, wicked nights, wicked feelings. Tk & Glizzy won’t rest until one of them controls the city. Following their daily struggles on the streets of Atlanta, we will soon see why the streets are divided & why family means nothing! Blood chaos & mayhem, the kind of betrayal that reminds us that no one can be trusted.

programme.title: Love Kills
programme.desc: In the heart of Atlanta's unpredictable dating scene, Darron is a hopeless romantic with the worst luck imaginable. Every time he believes he's found "the one," he ends up caught in another tangled web of passion, betrayal, and danger. When Darron finally meets someone who seems genuine, his past mistakes come back with a vengeance. One of his exes' jealous boyfriends discovers their hidden affair, setting off a chain of events that spirals out of control.

programme.title: Guilty Victim
programme.desc: A dangerous investor with a violent past is pulled back into chaos when a home security scheme spirals out of control, forcing him to confront old wounds, betrayal, and a brutal fight to protect what little he has left.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Drug kingpin Jay looks to expand his drug empire with the help of his business partners, and his girlfriend Passion. However, Polo and Marco have their own agenda’s, which could lead to chaos, as a potential drug war descends upon Atlanta.

programme.title: And They Named Her Love
programme.desc: Love, a hopeless romantic painter, sets out on a cross country journey to find herself in the competitive world of artistry. When a near death experience brings Atlanta based songstress Nasada into her life, she goes on a journey to find out that love and business do not always mix.

programme.title: Nowhere to be Found
programme.desc: Two sisters go on a senior trip to Mexico, led by Ava’s boyfriend Trent. Meanwhile, journalist Jessica Vandross is going to the same Mexican town in search of her sister’s killer after escaping a sex trafficking ring. These stories collide, in a thrilling fight for their lives.

programme.title: Office Secrets
programme.desc: Alvin work at a grueling corporate job, where he is constantly under foot of his drug addicted, gambling boss. He crosses paths with Victoria, who recently freed herself from a betrayal from her husband, but has an agenda all her own. Alvin plans to pull the curtain back on his boss, but has to watch his toes going against Victoria.

programme.title: Her Other Man
programme.desc: Looking to spice up their marriage, Kennedy invites another man, Billy, into the bedroom with her husband Ronny. When Billy is found dead, Ronny is being questioned about his murder.

programme.title: Baddies Revenge
programme.desc: After discovering her NFL-star boyfriend proposed to another woman live on television, Sierra turns her heartbreak turns into rage. She brings in her closest friends who have suffered betrayals of their own and begin to target the men that destroyed them emotionally.

programme.title: Receipts
programme.desc: Meeko, a high-level drug dealer, has built a thriving operation and a reputation to match. But when his supplier is suddenly killed and his entire network collapses, his supply chain runs dry with no chance of recovery. As a means to pivot, he resorts to a new business venture – blackmail.

programme.title: If I Can't Have You
programme.desc: Marc, a married man embarks on an affair with the seductive and enigmatic Marissa, that quickly turns into a nightmare. Lust quickly evolves into obsession when she realizes that Marc will never leave his wife. Marissa embarks on a deadly campaign of jealousy and deceit, leaving only destruction in her wake following the mantra "If I can't have you, no one else can." Marc must protect his family, while also confronting the darkest corners of his past that will define the course of his life.

programme.title: The Miracle of Tonya Pinkins
programme.desc: A musical biographical documentary about the life, times and career of Tony Award winner and Broadway performing star Tonya Pinkins (Jelly’s Last Jam, Play On, Caroline or Change) the movie chronicles her beginning as a professional child actress in Chicago to an award winning Broadway star, along with the stories and songs that made her one of America’s top performing artists.

programme.title: The Princess Killers
programme.desc: Two friends take a chance to change their lives and become partners in the world of crime, and build reputations as strong, no nonsense, business women. They soon discover it’s lonely at the top, when their enemies close in on them, while maintaining their own friendship.
